samir: Heads-up: launching a targeted admin-entropy sweep for billing/payment projects tomorrow. Scope = KMS ACLs, service-account grants, and any cross-project bindings. Aim: produce prune candidates + exceptions with owners and expiry. ETA 72h. Who wants KMS mapping? :eyes:

leo: I got KMS mapping. Will run a key inventory and export IAM policies. I'll also add key labels (env, owner) where missing.

tara: I'll own last-used for service accounts. Plan: run log-based lookups + token audit. Will post a script and results.

maya: Please include a note for any keys used by batch jobs that run less frequently than 30d. We previously tripped on monthly jobs.

devon: Ops: please schedule a short canary window Fri 04:00-05:00 UTC. Low traffic. We'll unbind in canary, watch for errors for 20-30m, then proceed.

samir: Canary plan approved. Requirements: (1) owners notified, (2) rollback playbook in runbook, (3) telemetry hooks enabled. If cross-project grants detected mark as high-risk and require manual sign-off.

leo: Commands I'll use: ```bash
# list keyrings
gcloud kms keyrings list --location=global --format="table(name,labels)"
# per-key policy
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy payments-key --location=global --keyring=payments-keyring --format=json
```
I'll write CSV: key, keyring, binding, member, label_owner, createTime.

tara: Last-used snippet (read-only): ```bash
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"svcacct-*.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"" --limit 1 --format="value(timestamp)"
```
I'll add a heuristic column: last_seen, log_count_90d.

ops-bot: scheduled window created: Fri 2024-06-14T04:00:00Z - 2024-06-14T05:00:00Z. Notifying infra oncall.

audit-bot: least-priv scan queued: /scans/least_priv/1745553210. Expected run: 2024-06-14T04:10:00Z. Output: /shared/audit/least-priv/1745553210/report.json

maya: Exceptions template: owner, justification, expiry (max 30d), rollback steps, evidence link. Post exceptions in the runbook page and ping me for approval.

samir: Important: do NOT prune any binding with roles/owner or roles/editor on prod infra projects without a canary + owner ack. If you see a service account with broad grants, mark :warning: and escalate.

leo: Uploaded initial KMS CSV: https://files.redwood/internal/priv-inv/1745553210/kms.csv. Found 7 keys with cross-project members and 11 bindings that look unused.

tara: Uploaded last-used CSV: https://files.redwood/internal/priv-inv/1745553210/last-used.csv. Marked 5 svcaccts as last_seen > 120d but two have monthly cron jobs (added note).

audit-bot: scan complete. Summary: 78 bindings scanned; 14 prune candidates; 7 cross-project grants flagged; 5 svcaccts stale (>120d). Full: /shared/audit/least-priv/1745553210/report.json

samir: Next steps: 1) leo/tara annotate each candidate with evidence + suggested action 2) owners notified (48h TTL) 3) infra prepare canary revert runbook 4) security will triage exceptions. We'll reconvene here after owner responses. :white_check_mark:
